title: Adds new director verification error codes to the Accounts API
summary: Adds verification_missing_directors, verification_directors_mismatch, verification_document_directors_mismatch, and verification_extraneous_directors as new error codes in the requirements.errors array in the Accounts API. To learn more, see Account requirements errors.

migrationNotes.text: Adds four new error codes to the requirements.errors array in the Accounts API for director verification issues. These codes provide specific information about director-related verification problems.

sources.quote: | [Adds new director verification error codes to the Accounts API](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2023-08-16/adds-director-verfication-error-accounts.md) | Connect | Breaking | api |

Adds `verification_missing_directors`, `verification_directors_mismatch`, `verification_document_directors_mismatch`, and `verification_extraneous_directors` as new error codes in the `requirements.errors` array in the Accounts API. To learn more, see [Account requirements errors](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20#account_object-requirements-errors).
